title: Awesome!!
text: Awesome!!. I love these precut sheets..no more rolling opposite way to get them to flatten on the tray. They fit well on the sheet and even in a baking dish. Easy to get out of the box because they dont stick together . Things cook good on them and nothing sticks. Great product!

product_metadata.title: 220 Pcs Unbleached Parchment Paper Baking Sheets, Baklicious Pre-cut Heavy Duty Parchment Baking Paper for Air Fryer, Oven, Bakeware, Steaming, Cooking Bread, CupCake, Cookies
features: PRE-CUT PARCHMENT PAPER SHEETS: 220 pcs 9 x 13 pre-cut parchment paper for baking. It saves you from the hassle of the cutting step of cooking. You take out a piece of parchments paper and spread it on the baking tray, making your baking process convenient and effectively avoiding measuring and cutting from a curled parchment roll.

NON-STICK & EASY TO CLEAN: Still worrying about the finishing work after baking? Our cooking parchment paper is waterproof & greaseproof, Food can be easily slid off from the baking tray, and you need to remove the paper and throw it away after baking. Heavy-duty parchment paper sheets for baking will reduce the trouble and time of cleaning the baking tray after cooking. Let you enjoy the fun of baking.

NATURAL, UNBLEACHED & HEALTHY MATERIAL: Baklicious natural parchment paper sheets are certified Food safe, made from natural wood pulp and fluorescent free, food-grade, unbleached, NON-TOXIC, and BPA-free.

HEAVY-DUTY BAKING PAPER: 45gsm thickness; it's thick enough to pick up cooked loaf of bread without disintegrating. Compared to the 35gsm paper, ours is stronger, more durable, and less brittle. It's about 15% thicker than others. So you can easily pick up the food on the baking sheet by lifting baking sheets of parchment paper without breaking.

MULTIPLE-PURPOSE: Our parchment paper for baking is suitable for baking, cooking, grilling, steaming, and storing food. Cooking bacon, roast potatoes, and vegetables, baking cookies and bread, parceling food, make biscuits and pizza, wrap fish, etc. There will be no scorching and liquid penetration of the pre-cut parchment baking paper sheets. Pre-cut baking parchment sheets is a very frequently used and easy-to-use item in the kitchen
